title: Simulation 3D Fisheye Camera
text: Fisheye camera sensor model in 3D simulation environment, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Distortion center (pixels)} sets the center of distortion, {Image size (pixels)} sets the image size produced by camera, {Mapping coefficients} sets the polynomial coefficients for projection function, {Stretch matrix} sets the transforms point from sensor plane to camera plane {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation of sensor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Rel Translation
ports.summary: Relative translation of sensor from mounting point (m) [0 0 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector of form [ X Y Z ]

ports.name: Rel Rotation
ports.summary: Relative rotation of sensor from mounting point (deg) [0 0 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector of form [ Roll Pitch Yaw ]

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 3D output camera image m -by- n -by-3 array of RGB triplet values

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Image size (pixels)
params.values: Image size produced by camera [720, 1280] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector of positive integers

params.name: Mapping coefficients
params.values: Polynomial coefficients for projection function [320, 0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-4 vector

params.name: Stretch matrix
params.values: Transforms point from sensor plane to camera plane [1, 0; 0, 1] (default) | real-valued 2-by-2 matrix

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of sensor off (default) | on
